what: Cases of taking terminal escapes and controls out of words, held by Central (ctrl/src/escape-cases.json; a notification's title is `line`, its body `block`) and by AIKit (crates/aikit-cli/src/escape-cases.json; a run's reason and summary are `record`, or `block` where no `record` stands). The same bytes in both, under one sha256.
why_record_differs: A record keeps a carriage return before its line break and makes any control that is not part of an escape a space, so words do not fuse; a notification drops both. A record is not trimmed.
